p1_smoke.finding: Negative result. In all 8 trials the fewest isosceles triples at cardinality 59 was 2, and it was the state immediately after forcing one point into the source 58 (swap 0). 200000 swaps and 9 restarts per trial never reached 1 or 0. The smoke shows the infrastructure works; it gives no evidence that this operator makes progress toward 59.

p1_iteration_2.finding: Negative result. None of the 80 destroy-four attempts reached depth 5, and all 80 ended by enumerating their whole search space far below the 20000-node cap. After removing four points only 4 or 5 cells had zero add cost: the four removed points and at most one other. The destroy-four neighbourhood of these 58-point sets is therefore almost rigid, and the node cap was never the limit. The swap fallback again stayed at 2 violations from swap 0. Under the plan's classification this is 'no progress'.

p1_iteration_3.finding: Negative result. None of the 80 destroy-eight attempts reached depth 9, and all 80 enumerated their whole search space far below the 200000-node cap. After removing eight points only 8 to 10 cells had zero add cost: the eight removed points and at most two others. The swap fallback again stayed at 2 violations from swap 0. The search hypothesis of iteration 3 is rejected.
